user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
The reason code depends on why you're disputing TX-0401 (240.00 EUR, TechMart Online, 2026-07-20, settled):

- **duplicate_charge** applies if you were charged twice for the same purchase. TX-0402 is also 240.00 EUR to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-14, so this may fit. The window is 60 days from the transaction date.
- **unauthorized_debit** applies if you did not make or approve this payment. The window is 56 days from the transaction date.
- **fraud_card_not_present** applies if your card details were used fraudulently for an online payment. The window is 120 days.
- **goods_not_received** applies if you paid and did not receive the goods. The window is 90 days.
- **service_not_rendered** applies if you paid for a service that was not provided. The window is 90 days.

Which of these matches what happened? If you tell me, I'll check eligibility before anything is opened. I haven't opened a dispute.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
